V.title: R3-B Lantern Heart Revenant, v2 (lit lantern, fatal chest wound)

items.concept: Wedged. The lit lantern sits crooked in the right side of his ribcage, handle pointing up past the lapel, as if it was pushed in and stuck halfway. A red stain spreads from the ribs to the belt. Slight stoop, head tilted toward the light, empty claws.
items.flavor: Somebody wanted your light. They gave it back the hard way, glass first, through the ribs. It's still burning. You keep looking down at it like you dropped something. You did.

items.concept: Bled Out. Same crooked, lit lantern, but the whole front is soaked: red down the ribs, waistcoat, coat sleeves and trouser legs. He sags to one side, skull dropped onto his shoulder, as if the lantern is too heavy to stand up under.
items.flavor: You know exactly how much blood a man holds now. It's all on the coat. The lantern drank the rest and kept burning. Lean in. It leans too. It always wanted to be closer to you.

items.concept: Slumped. The deepest hunch: spine curled, knees bent, jaw hanging open over the lantern. It sits low in the ribcage with the ribs cracked around its top, the flame lighting his jaw from below. Claws dangle at knee height.
items.flavor: He curls around the light like it's a secret. It is. It's the last thing that went into him and the only thing still warm. Your lantern. Your coat. Your bones. Different idea of where the light goes.
